decision_packet:
The 6 s, 0.10 Hz and 95% targets and 24/30 dB-Hz levels are hypothetical, not measured feasibility. Preserve frequency-only authority; score presence separately. Seed r733/r842 evidence calls for error tails and nonpublications, not CRB or finite uncertainty alone; compare block/Kay and coherent lags on matched captures, including resets, chunks, absent tone, and stationary versus changing conditions. Doppler spread is not established as oscillator drift. The seed Rife page locator exceeds its logged access; independent confirmation does not repair the researcher's provenance.

A real-tone negative spectral image can bias short-window frequency estimates: n641 F6 (2005 IEICE letter, CityUHK abstract OP05/official listing OP10; peer-reviewed institutional classification) and n273 F1 (2000 ISCAS paper pp. III-391–394, op3/op6; peer review unknown) share one mechanism. Vary start phase and aperture and test image correction, without assuming receiver benefit. n641 F7 (Quinn, Wiley abstract OP07, Macquarie peer-reviewed classification) cautions that a specific Kay estimator can be inconsistent under its model; verify variant identity and compare finite-aperture signed bias to a reference. Neither predicts receiver performance.

n685 F5 (Besson–Stoica, publisher-indexed abstract op08, direct page 403, peer review unknown) motivates comparing constant-amplitude and envelope-profile fits on matched stationary/ramped windows, with false admissions, nonpublications and computation. Real-envelope and additive-noise qualifiers are not confirmed by that abstract; model fit and budget remain open. n532 N-F1's J-STAGE abstract (op8, peer review unknown) supports GNSS double dwell, but its code periodicity has no established helper analogue and existing excerpts already stage looks; compare staged versus fixed only if a live policy choice, at matched false-publication rate. Transfer and incremental value remain unresolved.

Useful rejected leads: n273 interpolation may overlap seed coarse/fine work but was not independently rechecked; n532 Jaffer sequential DFT lacks accessible primary content; n685 GNSS numeric gains do not transfer. No architecture, calibrated confidence, false-publication rate or target success is established; expert review remains outstanding.
